name: systems-lab
description: A personal problems site for low-level systems knowledge. The site has no runtime dependencies; jsdom is only used to test it.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:unit: node tests/store.test.mjs && node tests/md.test.mjs && node tests/contrast.test.mjs && node tests/grade.test.mjs && node tests/runner.test.mjs && node tests/lint.test.mjs && node tests/judge.test.mjs && node tests/proxy.test.mjs && node tests/content.test.mjs
scripts.test:browser: node tests/browser/app.test.mjs && node tests/browser/styles.test.mjs && node tests/browser/states.test.mjs && node tests/browser/runner.test.mjs
scripts.test:ui: node tests/browser/navigation.test.mjs && node tests/browser/resize.test.mjs && node tests/browser/feedback.test.mjs && node tests/browser/usability.test.mjs
scripts.runner:stop: wsl.exe -d Ubuntu -- bash -lc "pkill -f 'judge/server.mjs' && echo stopped || echo 'nothing was running'"
